user.title: Smashrun personal access token
user.description: Open [this Smashrun page]({token_url}) while signed in to Smashrun, allow access and copy the access token it shows. You can paste the token alone or the whole address that contains `access_token=`. The token lasts about 60 days; when it expires, Home Assistant asks you for a new one.

data_description.import_history: Fills the long-term statistics of the history sensors (total distance and runs, distance and runs this week/month/year) with every run since your first one, in the background, so their graphs do not start today. You can also run it later from Configure or with the ha_smashrun.import_history action.

reauth_confirm.title: New Smashrun token
reauth_confirm.description: Smashrun no longer accepts the saved token (they expire about every 60 days). Get a new one on [this Smashrun page]({token_url}) and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Replace the Smashrun token
reconfigure.description: Paste a new token from [this Smashrun page]({token_url}), for example before the current one expires.

error.invalid_auth: Smashrun rejected the token. Check that you copied all of it and that it has not expired.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Smashrun account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Smashrun account than the one configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for a new run. The full history and the badges are only read again when a new run shows up (and once a day).

import_history.title: Import history
import_history.description: Reads every run in your Smashrun account and writes the past statistics of the history sensors (total distance and runs, distance and runs this week/month/year). Only the time before the integration started recording is written, so it is safe to run more than once. Select Submit to start.

error.import_failed: The import failed. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.import_done: Done. Found {runs} runs and wrote {points} hourly statistics points. They appear in the sensors' statistics graphs.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Fix its connection first (see the notifications), then try again.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Reads every run in your Smashrun account and writes the past long-term statistics of the history sensors, so their graphs go back to your first run. Safe to run more than once.

config_entry_id.name: Smashrun account
config_entry_id.description: Which Smashrun account to import. Leave empty to import all configured accounts.
